correctness.rationale: The latitude slicing uses normalized area dz dphi/(4pi). Alternating 2n longitudes at spacing delta=pi/n have uncovered interval [delta-A_+-A_-]_+, giving the exact all-radii integral even when individual caps cover whole parallels. At optimum the convex polytope has precisely two polar and 2n lateral triangular facets with equal support h*, and no other maximizing normals. The local polar tangent polygon is an n-gon of inradius 1 (area n tan delta); lateral tangent region has inequalities ±s y1 + c y2<1 and -y2<1, area (1+c)^2/(c s). Disjoint small contact patches exhaust the uncovered set by strict support gap elsewhere, and smooth nondegenerate active boundaries give O_n(epsilon³), yielding [2n tan delta+2n(1+c)²/(c s)]/(4pi)=K_n. Bernoulli product from m independent probes yields exp(-K_n x²). The asymptotic is fixed n, not joint-uniform; finite quadrature only corroborates.
